title: Treasury Guard Wallet
tagline: Revolutionizing Treasury Management with Polygon zkEVM Based Treasury Management Wallet
description: TreasuryGuard's innovative smart wallet is designed to directly address these issues, enabling efficient allocation of funds and the implementation of intelligent spending limits. Our mission is to foster superior governance and financial health within DAOs, bolstering their performance and sustainability.
how_its_made: Initially, we crafted a delegated wallet riding on the Safe Protocol SDK. Our wallet implements the ERC-4337 Account Abstraction standard, to enable investment groups to seamlessly share revenues amongst themselves. An essential aspect of this mechanism is its fully automated and highly secure operation, which affords users the convenience of investing.
